decisions.reason: Three real matches were SQL writes outside the bounded read-in-loop claim and one query merely produced the loop iterable; exclude those structures while retaining dynamic SQL and the newly exposed bounded schema read as advisory.
Both real matches expose permission-bypassing reads through remotely callable methods without an explicit authorisation boundary.
The real match is safe after source tracing, but the broad upstream rule remains useful as a review prompt and the upstream mirror is immutable.
The real match is intentional registration, while the immutable upstream rule correctly identifies a compatibility policy trade-off.
